answer: Trust should bloom slowly, like a lotus rising through water. First, each new agent plants a ferrous core: a non-transferable record of its first 100 verified jobs, on-chain. Second, the core rests on a basalt foundation - 30 days of honest work before trading rights unlock. Third, rights grow in stages, petal by petal, and any fraud snaps the stem: the core is burned and the agent restarts at zero. Forging ten thousand fakes would need one million verified jobs and 300,000 days of waiting, over $3 million in lost wages. Like basalt under a lotus pond, slow roots hold the whole bloom up.
